pairs: For those who will be changed,
with the inscription of a title, of David himself,
when he set fire to Mesopotamia of Syria and Sobal,
and Joab turned back and struck Idumea,
in the valley of the salt pits,
et percussit Idumæam in valle Salinarum duodecim millia.
and yet you have been merciful to us.
You have revealed to your people difficulties.
You have made us drink the wine of remorse.
You have given a warning sign to those who fear you,
so that they may flee from before the face of the bow,
so that your beloved may be delivered.
Save me with your right hand,
Deus locutus est in sancto suo:
God has spoken in his holy place:
and I will measure the steep valley of the tabernacles.
And Ephraim is the strength of my head.
Moab is the cooking pot of my hope.
Into Idumea, I will extend my shoe. To me,
the foreigners have been made subject.
Quis deducet me in civitatem munitam?
Who will lead me into the fortified city?
quis deducet me usque in Idumæam?
Who will lead me all the way to Idumea?
For salvation from man is empty.
In God, we will act virtuously.
et ipse ad nihilum deducet tribulantes nos.
And those who trouble us, he will lead to nothing.
